meta.name: hugging-science
meta.description: Use when the user is doing AI/ML work in a scientific domain such as biology, chemistry, physics, astronomy, climate, genomics, materials, medicine, ecology, energy, engineering, math, drug discovery, protein design, weather modeling, theorem proving, single-cell, or PDE solving. Hugging Science is a curated catalog of scientific datasets, models, blog posts, and interactive Spaces. This skill helps discover and use resources via `datasets`, `transformers`, the HF Inference API, `gradio_client`, and methodology citations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并使用科学领域的AI模型与数据集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做生物、化学、物理等科学领域的AI/ML工作
copy.tagline_en: Discover and use AI models and datasets for scientific domains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing AI/ML work in biology, chemistry, physics, or other scientific fields

howto.what: 当用户询问科学领域的AI/ML问题时，Claude会从Hugging Science的精选目录中查找科学数据集、模型、博客和交互式演示，并指导用户使用标准Hugging Face工具加载或运行这些资源。
howto.when: 当用户的任务涉及AI/ML应用于科学领域，例如提到蛋白质、基因组、分子、气候等科学主题，或询问是否存在某个科学数据集/模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个用于蛋白质设计的预训练模型。
say.note: Claude会从目录中推荐ESM2等模型。

say.text: 有没有关于气候建模的数据集？
say.note: Claude会从目录中查找并列出相关数据集。

say.text: 我想用BoltzGen设计一个蛋白质结合剂。
say.note: Claude会指导你通过Gradio客户端调用该Space。

howto.what_en: When the user asks AI/ML questions in scientific domains, Claude searches the Hugging Science curated catalog for scientific datasets, models, blog posts, and interactive demos, then guides the user to load or run them using standard Hugging Face tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user's task involves AI/ML applied to science, e.g., mentioning proteins, genomes, molecules, climate, or asking if a scientific dataset/model exists.

say_en.text: Find a pretrained model for protein design.
say_en.note: Claude will recommend models like ESM2 from the catalog.

say_en.text: Are there any datasets for climate modeling?
say_en.note: Claude will search the catalog and list relevant datasets.

say_en.text: I want to design a protein binder using BoltzGen.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to call the Space via gradio_client.
